expected_sha='8d518ff300c13d809f8d88d0a259a3d8f6ff59d6'
assert inv['source_sha']==expected_sha and not inv['tracked_status']
accepted={};readback={}
for rec,arm in zip(inv['records'],['RETAIN','LEARNED_EVENT']):
 tag=rec['tag'];run=p/tag/'run';sup=p/tag/'supervisor'

 assert (sup/'exit_code').read_text().strip()=='0' and (sup/'status').read_text().strip()=='finished'
 s=json.loads((run/'summary.json').read_text())
 wanted=dict(arm=arm,training_seed=7809,evaluation_seed=107809,launch_sha=expected_sha,status='complete',training_episodes=5000,training_ticks=100000,optimizer_steps=4969,evaluation_episodes=128,evaluation_ticks=2560)
 assert all(s[k]==v for k,v in wanted.items())
 arr=s['evaluation_returns'];assert len(arr)==128 and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in arr)
 mean=float(np.mean(arr));assert mean==s['mean_native_return']
 assert s['torch_threads']==[1,1] and s['torch_version']=='2.7.0+cu118' and s['numpy_version']=='1.26.3'
 checkpoint=torch.load(run/'final.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 assert checkpoint['arm']==arm and checkpoint['updates']==4969
 for name in ['actor','mixer','target_actor','target_mixer']:
  assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in checkpoint[name].values())
 for online,target in [('actor','target_actor'),('mixer','target_mixer')]:
  assert checkpoint[online].keys()==checkpoint[target].keys()
  assert all(torch.equal(v,checkpoint[target][k]) for k,v in checkpoint[online].items())
 states=checkpoint['optimiser']['state'];steps=[float(x['step']) for x in states.values()]
 assert all(x==4969 for x in steps)
 assert all(torch.isfinite(t).all() for st in states.values() for t in st.values() if isinstance(t,torch.Tensor))
 info=dict(identities_counts_finite_arrays_published_mean_pass=True,checkpoint_updates=checkpoint['updates'],checkpoint_actor_parameter_count=sum(v.numel() for v in checkpoint['actor'].values()),optimizer_parameter_states=len(states),optimizer_min_step=min(steps),optimizer_max_step=max(steps),online_target_exact_final_copy=True,all_published_network_optimizer_tensors_finite=True,conditional_return_sd=statistics.stdev(arr),minimum_return=min(arr),maximum_return=max(arr),training_return_mean=s['training_return_sum']/5000)
 if arm=='LEARNED_EVENT':
  w=checkpoint['actor']['retention_gate.weight'];b=checkpoint['actor']['retention_gate.bias'];assert list(w.shape)==[1,128] and list(b.shape)==[1]
  initial_bias=torch.tensor(math.log(99),dtype=b.dtype)
  displacement=math.sqrt(float(torch.sum(w.double()**2)+(b.double()-initial_bias.double()).square().sum()))
  assert displacement>0
  names=list(checkpoint['actor']);opt_ids=checkpoint['optimiser']['param_groups'][0]['params']
  gate_states={k:states[opt_ids[names.index(k)]] for k in ['retention_gate.weight','retention_gate.bias']}
  assert all(float(v['step'])==4969 and float(v['square_avg'].abs().sum())>0 for v in gate_states.values())
  info['gate']=dict(parameter_count=w.numel()+b.numel(),weight_shape=list(w.shape),bias_shape=list(b.shape),weight_l2=float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(w.double())),initial_bias_float32=float(initial_bias),final_bias=float(b.item()),bias_displacement=float(b.item()-initial_bias.item()),parameter_displacement_l2=displacement,nonzero_optimizer_square_avg=True,optimizer_steps_each=4969,distribution_of_applied_gate_values='not measured')
  assert s['training_events']['survivor_attenuations']==s['training_events']['survivor_opportunities']>0
  assert s['evaluation_events']['survivor_attenuations']==s['evaluation_events']['survivor_opportunities']>0
 else:
  assert not any(k.startswith('retention_gate.') for k in checkpoint['actor'])
  assert s['training_events']['survivor_attenuations']==0 and s['evaluation_events']['survivor_attenuations']==0
 assert s['training_events']['survivor_resets']==0 and s['evaluation_events']['survivor_resets']==0
 timing=next(run.glob('*whole_time.txt')).read_text()
 stamp=re.search(r'Elapsed .*?: ([0-9:.]+)',timing).group(1)
 seconds=0.0
 for part in stamp.split(':'):seconds=seconds*60+float(part)
 assert '\tExit status: 0' in timing and seconds<1800
 log=(sup/'task.log').read_text();headers=[x for x in log.splitlines() if x.startswith('===')]
 duration=int(re.search(r'Duration: (\d+)s',headers[-1]).group(1))
 log_summaries=[json.loads(x) for x in log.splitlines() if x.startswith('{') and '"status": "complete"' in x]
 assert len(log_summaries)==1 and log_summaries[0]==s
 progress=[json.loads(x) for x in log.splitlines() if x.startswith('{') and '"episode":' in x]
 assert [x['episode'] for x in progress]==list(range(200,5001,200))
 info['timing']=dict(runner_wall_seconds=s['wall_seconds'],whole_admission_runner_exit_seconds=seconds,supervisor_log_duration_seconds=duration,supervisor_header=headers[0],supervisor_terminal=headers[-1],runner_peak_rss_kib=s['peak_rss_kib'],whole_chain_peak_rss_kib=int(re.search(r'Maximum resident set size \(kbytes\): (\d+)',timing).group(1)),user_seconds=float(re.search(r'User time \(seconds\): ([0-9.]+)',timing).group(1)),system_seconds=float(re.search(r'System time \(seconds\): ([0-9.]+)',timing).group(1)),exit_code=0)
 info['progress_rows']=progress
 accepted[arm]=s;readback[arm]=info
primary=learned_primary(accepted['RETAIN']['evaluation_returns'],accepted['LEARNED_EVENT']['evaluation_returns'])
primary.update(independent_training_pairs=1,conditional_episode_rows_paired=False,training_seed_standard_error=None,absolute_MEI=1.0)
out=dict(technical_acceptance='PASS',source_sha=expected_sha,arms=accepted,readback=readback,primary=primary,training_mean_difference=readback['LEARNED_EVENT']['training_return_mean']-readback['RETAIN']['training_return_mean'],whole_native_sum_seconds=sum(x['timing']['whole_admission_runner_exit_seconds'] for x in readback.values()),runner_wall_sum_seconds=sum(x['timing']['runner_wall_seconds'] for x in readback.values()),cpu_user_system_sum_seconds=sum(x['timing']['user_seconds']+x['timing']['system_seconds'] for x in readback.values()),prediction=dict(DM='WITHIN_MEI',confidence='low',observed_branch=primary['rule'],score='miss',owner='not taken'))
